sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Traditional Nath – Ruby Red & White Stone Studded
sourceNotes.rawContent: Embrace traditional elegance with this gold-toned nath, featuring vibrant ruby-colored stones and a delicate pearl drop. This high-fashion piece is a stunning addition to any ethnic attire. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely after every wear.
